description.es-ES: Las cartas de Fray Luis de Granada reunidas por Cuervo (a Felipe II y su secretario Zayas, a san Carlos Borromeo, a Juan de Ribera, a los jesuitas Ribadeneira y Guzmán, al General de la Compañía y otros), 1560-1588.
description.en-US: The letters of Fray Luis de Granada gathered by Cuervo (to Philip II and his secretary Zayas, to St Charles Borromeo, to Juan de Ribera, to the Jesuits Ribadeneira and Guzmán, to the General of the Society and others), 1560-1588.
description.pt-BR: As cartas de Frei Luís de Granada reunidas por Cuervo (a Filipe II e seu secretário Zayas, a são Carlos Borromeu, a João de Ribera, aos jesuítas Ribadeneira e Guzmán, ao Geral da Companhia e outros), 1560-1588.

sources.edition: Fr. Luis de Granada, Obras, ed. Justo Cuervo OP, vol. 14 (Madrid: Viuda e hija de Gómez Fuentenebro, 1906-1908). Text of the pieces as Cuervo prints them.
sources.description: Letters I-XLV as the OCR gave them. OCR of the University of Toronto scan, cleaned by script (running heads, page numbers and the editor's prologue removed; lost initial capitals restored from the corpus vocabulary), not proofread.
sources.tierEvidence: Granada's text of the 16th century, reprinted in 1906; Cuervo's edition is in the public domain on archive.org.
